title: The Canadian star, Wvssim, brings a smash that feels good for every second on the new song."Dead To Me 2"
htmlContent:
Canada-based and coming-up star, Wvssim is a true student of the music game, having his hand in singing and songwriting. Wvssim has taken out all his to learn and improve on his craft and is currently Putting together music relatable to most young adolescents. The music star does not disappoint in releasing his latest single, "Dead To Me 2".

Wvssim's new single "Dead To Me 2" is a follow-up to the original ''Dead 2 Me'' that emphasizes how the person he showed the original version of himself became dead to him just like everyone else three years later. It is a representation that sometimes, no matter who you think will be different, it always ends up being the same.
